name: Brazilian Real Stablecoin
reason:
BRS (Brazilian Real Stablecoin) is issued by Nora Finance. 1 BRS = 1 BRL, fully backed, with monthly proof of reserves published at https://www.nora.finance/transparency and by Fact Finance (https://fact.finance/en/reserves/nora/).

- Website: https://www.nora.finance/
- Contract documentation: https://www.nora.finance/docs/integrate/core-concepts/brs-token
- CoinGecko: https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/nora-brazil-real
- Explorer: https://basescan.org/token/0x0000006238e3C7797Ae71827da303560bae1B125
- Official assets repository: https://github.com/Nora-Finance/brs-assets
- X: https://x.com/norafinancexyz

Liquidity on Base: Aerodrome SlipStream BRS/USDC, pool 0x4a1d178e12878ff05fa8711ef13f671d25be1811 (https://www.geckoterminal.com/base/pools/0x4a1d178e12878ff05fa8711ef13f671d25be1811), about US$17k of liquidity and US$39k of 24h volume on 12 Nov 2026. Base holds most of the supply (about 360k of 434k BRS).

We have not yet tested a trade on CoW Swap. Image requests for Base, Polygon and Mainnet are in #1594, #1595 and #1596.

Submitted by Bruno Moniz, co-founder and CFO of Nora Finance.
